purpose: Teach: 動脈/省令/偵察/定理/不合理/非行/射殺/勃発

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、動脈硬化の社会要因を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the social factors in atherosclerosis in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, measured curiosity. Genuine interest in his research direction. Slight upward lift at the end — inviting confirmation, not testing. Teacher-to-student, but present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、省令改正の影響を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at how the ministerial ordinance revision affected the outcomes.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Takes a breath before the key term — wanting to be clear and accurate. Slight self-consciousness about technical detail, but committed to getting it right.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、戦時下の偵察活動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: I see you examined wartime reconnaissance activities in your paper.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Processing something. Gentle confirmation rather than question — giving him space to respond or clarify. Quiet attentiveness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、数学の定理発見の歴史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Actually, I focused on the history of mathematical theorem discovery.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Slight hesitation — correcting politely, not defensively. Humble about the shift in direction. Almost apologetic in tone without saying sorry.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の不合理な構造を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you've been thinking about how irrational social structures work in your research.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning forward slightly in attention. Not quite a question — more of a observation she's inviting him to expand on. Respect for his intellectual seriousness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、青少年の非行問題を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, specifically juvenile delinquency and its social context.
lines.style: Straightforward, steady. Grounding the abstract in the specific. Small pause before naming the topic — it matters to him. Honest and unadorned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、要人射殺事件の影響史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You've looked at how the assassination of that key figure changed the course of events.
lines.style: Careful, respectful tone. Weighing words. Giving the weight of historical significance without melodrama. A teacher recognising something heavy in his work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、内戦勃発の背景を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I traced how the civil war actually began, and what triggered it.
lines.style: Concluding tone. Slightly more confident here — solid ground beneath this answer. Steady eye contact. A quiet period at the end, like he's finished a thought completely.
